list.title: Items
list.description: Everything you buy, sell, store or assemble.

create.title: Create item
create.description: Set up the item, its category and how it is measured.

steps.descriptionDetails: Set up the item, its category and how it is measured.
steps.descriptionPrices: Optional default prices. A bigger unit can cost less than the same amount of a smaller one.
steps.descriptionStock: Optional. Record the stock you already have, per location, in any unit of the item.

update.title: Edit item
update.description: Some settings are locked once the item has stock movements.

baseUnit.label: Base unit
baseUnit.description: A unit collection holding just this unit is created for the item.

unitCollection.label: Unit collection
unitCollection.description: Its base unit becomes the item’s base unit.

fields.unitExclusive: Choose either a base unit or a unit collection.

isExpiryTracked.label: Track expiry
isExpiryTracked.description: Requires batch tracking and inventory tracking.

reorderPoint.label: Reorder point
reorderPoint.description: In the item’s base unit. Optional.

fields.lockedHint: Locked because the item has stock movements.

openingStock.sectionDescription: Record initial inventory across locations. Optional.

postedAt.label: Posted date
postedAt.description: Defaults to today if left blank.

costPrice.label: Cost price
costPrice.description: Default purchase price per base unit. Prefilled on purchase orders, editable there. Optional.

sellingPrice.label: Selling price
sellingPrice.description: Default selling price per base unit. Prefilled on sales orders. Optional.

unitPrices.sectionDescription: All optional. Prices are per 1 of each unit, so a ton can cost less than 1000 kg. They prefill purchase and sales lines and can be changed there.
unitPrices.noOtherUnits: This unit collection has no other units. Add units to the collection to price them separately.

empty.title: No items found
empty.description: Try a different search or status.

delete.title: Delete item?
delete.description: “{name}” will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.

inventory.title: Inventory items
inventory.description: Stock levels across warehouses and storage locations.
inventory.empty: No inventory records found for the selected warehouse or location.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: Stock history, receipts, transfers, adjustments, and issues.
movements.empty: No stock movements recorded for this item.
